description_en: A knife-grinder turns his wheel by the roadside. He sharpens anything — but takes his fee in blood.
description_fr: Un rémouleur fait tourner sa meule au bord du chemin. Il affûte tout — mais se paie en sang.

choices.text_en: Hand him a rune (-10% max HP, +1 rune level)
choices.text_fr: Lui confier une rune (-10 % des PV max, +1 niveau de rune)
choices.result_text_en: The wheel sings, a drop of your blood beads on the stone — and the rune glows brighter.
choices.result_text_fr: La meule chante, une goutte de votre sang perle sur la pierre — et la rune brille plus fort.

choices.result_text_en: You leave the knife-grinder to his wheel.
choices.result_text_fr: Vous laissez le rémouleur à sa meule.
